model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Regulation (EU) 2019/943, as regards future-proofing electricity bills in the Union, through reducing system costs and fostering electrification and digitalisation

summary.text: This proposal seeks to modify rules on electricity pricing to make bills more affordable and sustainable by lowering overall system costs and encouraging more people and businesses to switch to electric power and digital technologies.
